ios.desc:
Discover everything about movies on myFilm. Explore details of the most popular films and keep up to date with the latest movie trends. Organize your watchlist in a practical and efficient way, without missing any favorite movies. Support for 38 languages and regional content in over 180 countries, all powered by The Movie Database. Download now and immerse yourself in the world of movies!

With myFilm, you can:
- Manage your Watch List: Organize and manage your list of favorite movies with ease.
- Search Movies: Browse movies, actors and more to explore the vast world of cinema.
- Discover New Movies: Stay on top of the latest movie trends and discover new releases.
- Multilingual Support: Support for 39 languages and regional data in over 180 countries.
- Exploration: Intuitive interface that makes it easy to navigate and discover new content.
- Advanced Filters: Find exactly what you're looking for with advanced search filters.

Upgrade to MyFilm Pro:
- Unlimited Movie Collection: Add as many movies as you want to your collection.
- Smart Movie Collection: Organize your movies in a smart, personalized way.
- Full Content Access: Get full access to all content.
- All Widgets: Use all the widgets available to personalize your experience.
Enjoy the Pro version with a make a one-time purchase for lifetime access.
Download myFilm now and explore the world of cinema!

My Pro is available for purchase as a one-time lifetime purchase.
